function S:ApplyTheme(w)
if (not w) then
return
end
local o = self:GetCustomTheme(w)
local i = o or self.BuiltInThemes[w]
if not i then
return
end
if self.Library.InnerVideoBackground ~= nil then
self.Library.InnerVideoBackground.Visible = false
end
local w = i[2]
for i, T in next, o or w do
if i:find("Color") then
self.Library[i] = Color3.fromHex(T)
if const_0[i] then
const_0[i]:SetValueRGB(Color3.fromHex(T))
end
else
self.Library[i] = T
if const_0[i] then

const_0[i]:SetValue(T)
end
end
end
self:ThemeUpdate()
end
function S:ThemeUpdate()
if self.Library.InnerVideoBackground ~= nil then
self.Library.InnerVideoBackground.Visible = false
end
local w = { "Contrast", "Saturation", "Brightness", "BlurSize", "FontColor",
"RiskColor", "MainColor", "AccentColor", "BackgroundColor", z[3][z[2]], "SwordColor",
"ItemType", "BackTransparency", "BackColor", "SwordTransparency", "SwordReflectance",
"SwordMaterial", "SwordSpeed" }
for o, o in next, w do
if const_0 and const_0[o] then
self.Library[o] = const_0[o].Value
end
end
self.Library.AccentColorDark = self.Library:GetDarkerColor(self.Library.AccentColor)
self.Library:UpdateColorsUsingRegistry()
end
function S:LoadDefault()
local w = "Default"
local o = isfile(self.Folder .. "/themes/default.txt") and readfile(self.Folder .. "/themes/
default.txt")
local i = true
if o then
if self.BuiltInThemes[o] then
w=o
elseif self:GetCustomTheme(o) then
w=o
i = false
end
elseif self.BuiltInThemes[self.DefaultTheme] then
w = self.DefaultTheme
end
if i then
const_0.ThemeManager_ThemeList:SetValue(w)
else
self:ApplyTheme(w)
end
end
function S:SaveDefault(w)
writefile(self.Folder .. "/themes/default.txt", w)
end
function S:Delete(w)
if (not w) then
return false, "no config file is selected"
end
local o = self.Folder .. "/themes/" .. w
if not isfile(o) then
return false, "invalid file"
end

local w, i = pcall(delfile, o)
if not w then
return false, "delete file error"
end
return true
end
function S:GetCustomTheme(w)
if (not w) then
return
end
local o = self.Folder .. "/themes/" .. w
if not isfile(o) then
return nil
end
local w = readfile(o)
local o, i = pcall(Z.JSONDecode, Z, w)
if not o then
return nil
end
return i
end
function S:SaveCustomTheme(w)
if not w or w:gsub(" ", "") == "" then
return self.Library:Notify("Invalid file name for theme (empty)", 3)
end
local o = {}
local i = { "Contrast", "Saturation", "Brightness", "BlurSize", "FontColor",
"RiskColor", "MainColor", "AccentColor", "BackgroundColor", z[3][z[2]], "ItemType",
"SwordColor", "BackTransparency", "BackColor", "SwordTransparency", "SwordReflectance",
"SwordMaterial", "SwordSpeed" }
for z, z in next, i do
if (const_0[z]) then
if not z:find("Color") then
o[z] = const_0[z].Value
else
o[z] = const_0[z].Value:ToHex()
end
end
end
writefile(self.Folder .. "/themes/" .. w, Z:JSONEncode(o))
end
function S:ReloadCustomThemes()
local w = listfiles(self.Folder .. "/themes")
local z = {}
for M = 1, #w do
local Z = w[M]
if Z:sub(-5) == ".json" then
local w = Z:find(".json", 1, true)
local M = Z:sub(w, w)
while M ~= "/" and M ~= "\\" and M ~= "" do
w=w-1
M = Z:sub(w, w)
end
if M == "/" or M == "\\" then

table.insert(z, Z:sub(w + 1))
end
end
end
return z
end

end
function S:BuildFolderTree()
local w = {}
local z = self.Folder:split("/")
for M = 1, #z do
w[#w + 1] = table.concat(z, "/", 1, M)
end
table.insert(w, self.Folder .. "/themes")
for z = 1, #w do
local M = w[z]
if not isfolder(M) then
makefolder(M)
end
end
end
function S:SetFolder(w)
self.Folder = w
self:BuildFolderTree()
end

local Ragebot = (function()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Modules = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"))
local CONSTANTS = require(Modules:WaitForChild("CONSTANTS"))
local utility = require(Modules:WaitForChild("utility"))
local ClientFighter = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.ClientFighter)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"))
local Replication = Remotes:WaitForChild("Replication")
local FighterRemote = Remotes:WaitForChild("Fighter")
local UseItemRemote = FighterRemote:WaitForChild("UseItem")
local IS_PRIVATE_SERVER = game.PlaceId == CONSTANTS.IS_PRIVATE_SERVER
local Ragebot = {}
Ragebot.__index = Ragebot
local function randomUnitVector()
return Random.new():NextUnitVector()
end
local function generateGUID()
return HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
end
function Ragebot.new()
local self = setmetatable({}, Ragebot)
self.characters = {}
self.duelCache = {}
self.priorities = {}
self.voidedPlayers = {}
self.attackNum = 0
self.heavyAttackNum = 0
self.reloadCooldown = 0
self.lastAttack = 0
self.attackThread = nil
self.reloadThreads = {}
self.desync = {
enabled = false,
pitch = 0,
yaw = 0,
customPitch = 0,
customYaw = 0,
floorHide = false,
physicsRep = nil,
}
self.status = {
enabled = false,
text = "",
weapon = nil,

}
self.events = {
force_cframe_change = Instance.new("BindableEvent"),
ragebot_status = Instance.new("BindableEvent"),
}
self:trackCharacters()
self:setupValidation()
self:setupAntiAim()
self:setupVoidPosition()
self:setupVoidSpam()
self:setupPriorityTargeting()
self:setupIndicator()
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
if not Toggles.ragebot_enabled.Value then
self.status.enabled = false
return
end
self.status.enabled = true
end)
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if Toggles.ragebot_enabled.Value and Toggles.ragebot_void_spam.Value then
if self.attackThread and coroutine.status(self.attackThread) ~= "dead" then
return
end
self.attackThread = task.spawn(function()
self:voidLoop()
end)
end
end)
return self
end
function Ragebot:trackCharacters()
local function add(plr, char)
self.characters[plr] = char
self.duelCache[plr] = cloneref(char)
end
local function remove(plr)
self.characters[plr] = nil
self.duelCache[plr] = nil
self.priorities[plr] = nil
self.voidedPlayers[plr] = nil
end
local function hook(plr)
if plr.Character then add(plr, plr.Character) end
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) add(plr, char) end)
plr.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() remove(plr) end)
end
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hook(plr) end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hook)
end
function Ragebot:setupValidation()
local function hasFlag(char, name)
local flag = char and char:FindFirstChild(name)
return flag ~= nil
end
function self:isAlly(char)
local flag = char and char:FindFirstChild("_is_ally")
return flag ~= nil and flag.Value == true
end
function self:isAlive(char)
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
return hum ~= nil and hum.Health > 0
end
function self:getClientFighter(char)
local client = char and char:FindFirstChild("ClientFighter")
return client or (char and char:GetAttribute("client_fighter"))
end
function self:getHitbox(char)
local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HitboxHead") or char:FindFirstChild("Head"))
return head or (char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
end
function self:validateTarget(char)
if not char then return false end
if self:isAlly(char) then return false end
if not self:isAlive(char) then return false end
if not self:getClientFighter(char) then return false end
if not hasFlag(char, "Health") then return false end
return true
end
end

function self:desyncCFrame(hrp)
local base = hrp.CFrame
local yaw = math.rad(self.desync.yaw)
local pitch = math.rad(self.desync.pitch)
local customYaw = math.rad(self.desync.customYaw)
local customPitch = math.rad(self.desync.customPitch)
return CFrame.new(base.Position)
* CFrame.Angles(0, yaw + customYaw, 0)
* CFrame.Angles(pitch + customPitch, 0, 0)
end

self.desync.yaw = Options.anti_aim_yaw.Value
self.desync.customPitch = Options.anti_aim_custom_pitch.Value

rep.CFrame = hrp.CFrame

function Ragebot:setupVoidPosition()
local self = self
local cache = {}
local function collectBarriers()
local barriers = {}
local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
local barrierFolder = map and map:FindFirstChild("Barriers")
if barrierFolder then
for _, part in ipairs(barrierFolder:GetChildren()) do
if part:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(barriers, part)
end
end
end
return barriers
end
local function collectSpawns()
local positions = {}
local spawns = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spawns")
if not spawns then return positions end
for _, obj in ipairs(spawns:GetDescendants()) do
if obj:IsA("Model") then
local pos = obj:FindFirstChild("Position")
if pos and pos:IsA("Vector3Value") then
table.insert(positions, pos.Value)
end
elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(positions, obj.Position)
end
end
return positions
end
function self:getVoidPosition()
local now = tick()
if cache.expire and now < cache.expire and cache.position then
return cache.position
end
local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Whitelist
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = collectBarriers()
params.BruteForceAllSlow = true
local candidates = collectSpawns()
for _, origin in ipairs(candidates) do
local from = origin + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
local result = workspace:Raycast(from, Vector3.new(0, -500, 0), params)

if result then
local hit = result.Position
if hit.Y < 0 then
cache.position = hit
cache.expire = now + 1
return hit
end
end
end
if cache.position then
return cache.position
end
return nil
end
function self:voidPositionOrFallback()
return self:getVoidPosition() or (LocalPlayer.Character and
LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and
LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
end
end

function self:voidSpamMelee(target)
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
local item = getEquippedItem(myChar)
if not item then return false end
if item.Info and item.Info.Type ~= "Melee" then return false end
local now = tick()
local cooldown = item.Info and item.Info.HeavyAttackCooldown or 0.2
if now - self.lastAttack < cooldown then
return false
end
self.lastAttack = now
self.heavyAttackNum = self.heavyAttackNum + 1
local hitbox = self:getHitbox(target)
if not hitbox then return false end
local aimPos = hitbox.Position + randomUnitVector() * 0.35
local rotation = getRotationCFrame(hasRiotShield(target) and hitbox or target)
local ok = fireUseItem({
id = generateGUID(),
objectId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
item = Options.ragebot_weapon.Value,
position = aimPos,
heavyAttackNum = self.heavyAttackNum,
animationKeys = getAnimationKeys(item),
rotation = rotation,
one = Vector3.one,
startAiming = true,
packed = { "\x00", "\x01", "\x02", "\x03" },
})
if ok then
pcall(function()
item:StartAiming(aimPos)
end)
pcall(function()
item:HeavyAttack(aimPos)
end)
self.status.text = string.format("stabbing %s in %s... (void)", target.Name,
tostring(aimPos))
else
self.status.text = "void... (backstabbing)"
end
return ok
end

function self:baitPlayers()
-- ragebot_bait: pull voided players into targeting range by
-- marking them as high-priority bait targets
if not Toggles.ragebot_bait.Value then return end

for player, char in pairs(self.characters) do

function self:voidLoop()
if not Toggles.ragebot_enabled.Value then return end
if not Toggles.ragebot_void_spam.Value then return end
if not self:keyHeld() then return end
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
if not myChar then return end
local item = getEquippedItem(myChar)
if not item then
self.status.text = "no usable item(s)... (void)"
equipItem(myChar, Options.ragebot_weapon.Value)
return
end
local target = self:getPriorityTarget()
if not target then return end
local mode = Options.ragebot_mode.Value or "gun"
local weaponType = item.Info and item.Info.Type
if mode == "gun" and weaponType == "Melee" then
-- prefer projectile weapon (ragebot_settings)
local settings = Options.ragebot_settings.Value or {}
if settings["prefer projectile weapon"] then
pcall(function()
item:EquipItem(Options.ragebot_weapon.Value)
end)
return
end
end
local data = item.Data
local ammo = data and data.Ammo
local reserve = data and data.AmmoReserve
local now = tick()
if weaponType == "Gun" then
if ammo and ammo <= 0 then
if reserve and reserve > 0 then
if now > self.reloadCooldown then
self.status.text = "reloading..."
pcall(function()
item:StartReloading()
end)
self.reloadCooldown = now + 0.4
table.insert(self.reloadThreads, tick())
end
return

end
local settings = Options.ragebot_settings.Value or {}
if settings["swap weapons when empty"] then
equipItem(myChar, Options.ragebot_weapon.Value)
self.status.text = "swap weapons when empty"
end
return
end
if item.Name == "Revolver" then
self.attackNum = self.attackNum + 1
local hitbox = self:getHitbox(target)
local aimPos = hitbox.Position + randomUnitVector() * 0.5
fireUseItem({
id = generateGUID(),
item = Options.ragebot_weapon.Value,
position = aimPos,
attackNum = self.attackNum,
animationKeys = getAnimationKeys(item),
rotation = getRotationCFrame(hitbox),
})
self.status.text = "killing " .. target.Name .. " (Revolver)"
return
end
self:voidSpamRanged(target)
return
end
if weaponType == "Melee" then
self:voidSpamMelee(target)
return
end
equipItem(myChar, Options.ragebot_weapon.Value)
self.status.text = "void..."
end
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
if not Toggles.ragebot_enabled.Value then return end
if not Toggles.ragebot_void_spam.Value then return end
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
if not myChar then return end
local item = getEquippedItem(myChar)
if not item then return end
local weaponType = item.Info and item.Info.Type
if weaponType ~= "Gun" and weaponType ~= "Melee" then
self.status.text = "no usable item(s)... (void)"
end
end)
end
function Ragebot:setupPriorityTargeting()
local self = self

function self:addPriority(player, level)
self.priorities[player] = level
if Toggles.ragebot_priority_notification.Value then
Library:Notify("added " .. player.Name .. " to ragebot priority", 2)
end
end
function self:removePriority(player)
self.priorities[player] = nil
end
function self:markVoided(player)
self.voidedPlayers[player] = true
end
function self:unmarkVoided(player)
self.voidedPlayers[player] = nil
end
function self:getPriorityTarget()
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local origin = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
if not origin then return nil end
local settings = Options.ragebot_priority_settings.Value or {}
local targets = Options.ragebot_priority_targets.Value or {}
self:baitPlayers()
local best, bestScore = nil, math.huge
for player, char in pairs(self.characters) do
if player ~= LocalPlayer then
if not self:validateTarget(char) then continue end
local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if hrp then
local dist = (hrp.Position - origin).Magnitude
local priority = self.priorities[player] or 0
local weight = 500
if priority > 0 then
weight = weight + priority * 100
end
local score = dist - weight
if self.voidedPlayers[player] then
score = score - 10000
end
if score < bestScore then
bestScore = score
best = char
end
end
end
end
return best
end

end
function Ragebot:setupIndicator()

if now - lastUpdate < 0.1 then return end
lastUpdate = now
self.status.enabled = Toggles.ragebot_enabled.Value
if not self.status.enabled then
self.status.text = ""
return
end
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
if not myChar then return end
local item = myChar:FindFirstChild("EquippedItem")
local weaponType = item and item.Info and item.Info.Type
if weaponType == "Gun" then
self.status.text = "ragebot"
self.status.weapon = item.Name
elseif weaponType == "Melee" then
local name = item.Name or "Knife"
self.status.text = "ragebot: " .. name
self.status.weapon = item
else
self.status.text = "invalid weapons for ragebot"
self.status.weapon = nil
end
if Toggles.indicator_ragebot.Value then
local style = Options.indicator_ragebot_style.Value
self.events.ragebot_status:Fire(self.status.text)
end
end)
end

return self:addPriority(player, level)
end

local Triggerbot = (function()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Triggerbot = {}
Triggerbot.__index = Triggerbot
local HITBOX_WHITELIST = {
HitboxBody = true,
HitboxHead = true,
PhysicalHitboxHead = true,
HitboxBodySmall = true,
HitboxHeadSmall = true,
FakeMass = true,
}
function Triggerbot.new(clientFighter, clientItem, input)
local self = setmetatable({}, Triggerbot)
self.clientFighter = clientFighter
self.clientItem = clientItem
self.input = input or (clientItem and clientItem.Input)
self.rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
self.rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

self.lastTargetTime = 0
self.lastTarget = nil
self.nextTargetDelay = 0
local function addToFilter(filter, container)
if container and container.Parent then
table.insert(filter, container)
end
return filter
end
local function buildFilter()
local filter = {}
addToFilter(filter, workspace:FindFirstChild("characters"))
addToFilter(filter, workspace:FindFirstChild("viewmodels"))
addToFilter(filter, LocalPlayer.Character)
self.rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
self.rayParams.CollisionGroup = "NoCollide"
return filter
end
local function getEquippedItem(character)
return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or (character and
character:FindFirstChild("EquippedItem"))
end
local function isScopedAndAiming(item)
if not item then return false end
local scoped = Options.triggerbot_scoped.Value or {}
for weaponName, enabled in pairs(scoped) do
if enabled and (item.Name == weaponName or (item.Info and item.Info.Name ==
weaponName)) then
local stateOk, state = pcall(function()
return item:GetState()
end)
if stateOk and (state == Enum.ItemState.Equipped or state ==
Enum.ItemState.Active) then
local aiming = item.IsFullyAiming and pcall(function()
return item:IsFullyAiming()
end) or false
if aiming then
return true
end
end
return true
end
end
return false
end
local function rayToTarget()
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return nil end

buildFilter()
local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
local direction = cam.CFrame.LookVector
local maxDistance = Options.triggerbot_max_distance.Value
local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * maxDistance, self.rayParams)
if not result then return nil end
local instance = result.Instance
if not instance then return nil end
local blacklist = Options.triggerbot_part_blacklist.Value or {}
if blacklist[instance.Name] then
return nil
end
if not HITBOX_WHITELIST[instance.Name] then
return nil
end
local character = instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
if not character then return nil end
local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return nil end
local ally = character:FindFirstChild("_is_ally")
if ally and ally.Value then return nil end
local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
if player == LocalPlayer then return nil end
return {
part = instance,
character = character,
player = player,
position = result.Position,
}
end
local function antiKatanaCheck(character)
local settings = Options.triggerbot_settings.Value or {}
if not settings["anti katana"] then return true end
local equipped = getEquippedItem(character)
if not equipped then return true end
local info = equipped.Info
if not info then return true end
local itemType = info.Type
return itemType ~= "Melee" and equipped.Name ~= "Katana"
end
local function shouldShoot()

if not Toggles.triggerbot_enabled.Value then return false end
if not self:keyHeld() then return false end
local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
local item = getEquippedItem(myChar)
if not item then return false end
local info = item.Info
local itemType = info and info.Type
local settings = Options.triggerbot_settings.Value or {}
if itemType == "Gun" then
local canAim = item.IsFullyAiming and item:IsFullyAiming() or false
if settings["scoped only"] and not canAim then
return false
end
end
local now = tick()
local forgetSeconds = forgetTime
if self.lastTarget and now - self.lastTargetTime > forgetSeconds then
self.lastTarget = nil
end
if settings["no delay between targets"] then
self.nextTargetDelay = 0
end
return true
end
local function tryShoot()
if not shouldShoot() then return end
local target = rayToTarget()
if not target then return end
local now = tick()
if self.lastTarget and target.character ~= self.lastTarget then
if now - self.lastTargetTime < self.nextTargetDelay then
return
end
end
self.lastTarget = target.character
self.lastTargetTime = now
if not antiKatanaCheck(target.character) then
return
end
local reaction = Options.triggerbot_reaction_time.Value
local offset = Options.triggerbot_reaction_time_offset.Value
local shootDelay = Options.triggerbot_shoot_delay.Value

task.delay((reaction + offset) / 1000, function()
task.wait(shootDelay / 1000)
if not Toggles.triggerbot_enabled.Value then return end
if not self:keyHeld() then return end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
if self.clientItem then
self.clientItem:StartShooting(target.position)
elseif self.input then
self.input(nil)
end
end)
if not ok then
pcall(function()
if self.input then
self.input(nil)
end
end)
end
end)
end
function self:keyHeld()
local mode = Toggles.triggerbot_keybind.Mode
local key = Toggles.triggerbot_keybind.Value
if mode == "Always" then
return true
end
if mode == "Hold" then
return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(key)
end
if mode == "Toggle" then
return Toggles.triggerbot_keybind.KeyDown
end
return true
end
local forgetTime = Options.triggerbot_forget_time.Value
Options.triggerbot_forget_time.OnChanged:Connect(function(value)
forgetTime = value
end)
local function onHeartbeat()

end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(onHeartbeat)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
buildFilter()
end)
Options.triggerbot_scoped.OnChanged:Connect(function() end)

Options.triggerbot_max_distance.OnChanged:Connect(function() end)

local SilentAim = (function()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local SilentAim = {}
SilentAim.__index = SilentAim
local FONT_NAMES = {
"monocraft",
"monocraft bold",
"ubuntu",
"tahoma",
"proggy clean",
"proggy tiny",
"pixel arial",
"smallest pixel",
}
local FONT_SIZES = {
["smallest pixel"] = 8,
["proggy tiny"] = 10,
["pixel arial"] = 11,
}
local DEFAULT_FONT = Enum.Font.Ubuntu
local function fontFor(name)
if not name then return DEFAULT_FONT end
local lower = string.lower(name)
if string.find(lower, "monocraft") then return DEFAULT_FONT end
if string.find(lower, "ubuntu") then return Enum.Font.Ubuntu end

if string.find(lower, "tahoma") then return Enum.Font.Tahoma end
if string.find(lower, "proggy") then return Enum.Font.Code end
if string.find(lower, "arial") then return Enum.Font.Arial end
if string.find(lower, "pixel") then return Enum.Font.Arial end
return DEFAULT_FONT
end
local function applyFont(drawing, fontName, size)
pcall(function()
drawing.Font = fontFor(fontName)
end)
local fontSize = FONT_SIZES[fontName] or size or 12
pcall(function()
drawing.Size = fontSize
end)
return fontSize
end
local function textBounds(text, font, size)
local params = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
params.Text = text
params.Size = size or 12
params.Font = font or DEFAULT_FONT
local ok, bounds = pcall(function()
return TextService:GetTextBoundsAsync(params)
end)
return ok and bounds or Vector2.new(size or 12, size or 12)
end
local function makeDrawing(kind)
return Drawing.new(kind)
end
function SilentAim.new(events)

self.fovCircle.Filled = false
self.fovCircle.Visible = false
self.fovFill = makeDrawing("Circle")
self.fovFill.Thickness = 1
self.fovFill.Filled = true
self.fovFill.Visible = false
self.fovOutline = makeDrawing("Circle")
self.fovOutline.Thickness = 2
self.fovOutline.Filled = false

self.fovOutline.Visible = false
self.targetLine = makeDrawing("Line")
self.targetLine.Thickness = 1

local function rebuildGradients(prefix, target)
local gradients = target or {}
local options = {}
local index = 1
while true do
local option = Options[prefix .. index]
if not option then break end
table.insert(options, option)
index = index + 1
end
if #options == 0 then
return gradients
end
local keypoints = {}
for i, option in ipairs(options) do
local t = (#options > 1) and ((i - 1) / (#options - 1)) or 0
table.insert(keypoints, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(t, option.Color))
end
if gradients.color then
gradients.color = ColorSequence.new(keypoints)
end
if gradients.transparency then
local trans = {}
for i, option in ipairs(options) do
local t = (#options > 1) and ((i - 1) / (#options - 1)) or 0
table.insert(trans, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(t, option.Transparency))
end
gradients.transparency = NumberSequence.new(trans)
end
return gradients
end
self.gradients = {

silent = { color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), transparency =
NumberSequence.new(0) },
silent_fill = { color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), transparency =
NumberSequence.new(0) },
silent_outline = { color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0, 0, 0)), transparency =
NumberSequence.new(0) },
}
local function updateSilentGradients()
self.gradients.silent = rebuildGradients("silent_color", self.gradients.silent)
self.gradients.silent_fill = rebuildGradients("silent_fill_color", self.gradients.silent_fill)
self.gradients.silent_outline = rebuildGradients("silent_outline_color",
self.gradients.silent_outline)
local rot = Options.silent_fov_rotation.Value
self.fovCircle.Color = Options.silent_color1.Value
self.fovFill.Color = Options.silent_fill_color1.Value
self.fovOutline.Color = Options.silent_outline_color1.Value
end

end
if self.events then

end

self.events.esp_fill_changed.Event:Connect(updateSilentGradients)
end

end)
end

if dot < math.cos(math.rad(Options.aimbot_radius.Value)) then
return
end
local matchAxis = Options.aimbot_match_axis.Value
local smoothing = Options.aimbot_smoothing.Value
if matchAxis == "y" then
local yaw = math.atan2(
target.position.X - cam.CFrame.Position.X,
target.position.Z - cam.CFrame.Position.Z
)
local pitch = math.asin(math.clamp(
(target.position.Y - cam.CFrame.Position.Y)
/ (target.position - cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude, -1, 1
))
local currentYaw = math.atan2(cam.CFrame.LookVector.X, cam.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
local delta = (yaw - currentYaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(cam.CFrame.Position)
* CFrame.Angles(0, delta * smoothing, 0)
* CFrame.Angles(-pitch * smoothing, 0, 0)
else
cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position,
target.position), smoothing)

end

function self:smoothPosition(targetPos, dt)

self.delay.y = self.delay.y + (targetPos.Y - self.delay.y) * math.clamp(sy * dt, 0, 1)

end

local Movement = (function()

return LocalPlayer.Character and
LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local function flyLoop(step)
if not Toggles.movement_fly.Value then return end
if not self:keyHeld() then return end
if isTyping() then return end
if self.currentVehicle then return end
local hum = getHumanoid()
if not hum then return end
local root = getRootPart()
if not root then return end
hum.PlatformStand = true
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local cf = root.CFrame
local move = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move = move +
cam.CFrame.LookVector end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move = move cam.CFrame.LookVector end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move = move cam.CFrame.RightVector end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move = move +
cam.CFrame.RightVector end
if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move = move + Vector3.yAxis
end
local speed = Options.movement_flyvalue.Value
if move.Magnitude > 0 then
move = move.Unit * speed
end
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = cf:VectorToWorldSpace(move)
root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
local yaw = select(2, cam.CFrame:ToOrientation())
root.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
end
function self:noclipHeld()

local key = Toggles.movement_noclipkeybind.Value
if mode == "Always" then return true end

if mode == "Toggle" then return Toggles.movement_noclipkeybind.KeyDown end
return true
end

if not Toggles.movement_noclip.Value then return end

part.CanCollide = false
part.CanTouch = false
part.CanQuery = false
end
end
end

if mode == "Hold" then return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(key) end
if mode == "Toggle" then return Toggles.movement_velocitykeybind.KeyDown end

end

local lastJump = 0
local jumpsUsed = 0
local function doubleJumpLoop()

if not hum then return end
local root = getRootPart()
if not root then return end

local grounded = hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Idle

jumpsUsed = 0
return
end

hum.JumpPower * height,
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z
)
end
end
end

local function cycleColor()
self.colorIndex = self.colorIndex + 1
return self.colors[(self.colorIndex % #self.colors) + 1]
end
local function getType()
return Options.hit_effects_selected.Value or "fortnite damage"
end
self.stackWindows = {}
local STACK_WINDOW = 0.15
local function stackDamage(character, damage)
local now = tick()
local existing = self.stackWindows[character]
if existing and now - existing.time < STACK_WINDOW then
existing.damage = existing.damage + damage
existing.time = now
local label = existing.label
if label then
label.Text = tostring(math.round(existing.damage))
end
return true
end
return false
end

self:spawnParticleBurst(targetCharacter or workspace, hitPosition)

end

effect:Destroy()
end)
end

end)
end

self.markers = {}
self.particles = {}
end

local function updatePlayerState(player, character)

end

function ESP:computeCorners(part)
local size = part.Size / 2
local corners = {}
local x, y, z = size.X, size.Y, size.Z
table.insert(corners, Vector3.new(-x, -y, -z))
table.insert(corners, Vector3.new(-x, -y, z))
table.insert(corners, Vector3.new(-x, y, -z))
table.insert(corners, Vector3.new(-x, y, z))
table.insert(corners, Vector3.new(x, -y, -z))
table.insert(corners, Vector3.new(x, -y, z))
table.insert(corners, Vector3.new(x, y, -z))
table.insert(corners, Vector3.new(x, y, z))
return corners
end

function ESP:computeBounds(state)
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local dynamic = Options.esp_bounds_type.Value == "dynamic"
local widthScale = Options.esp_bounds_width_scale.Value / 100
local function worldToScreen(position)
local screen, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
return Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y), onScreen
end
if dynamic then
local minX, minY = math.huge, math.huge
local maxX, maxY = -math.huge, -math.huge
local valid = false
for partName, part in pairs(state.parts) do
local corners = state.corners[partName]
if not corners then continue end
for _, offset in ipairs(corners) do
local screen, onScreen = worldToScreen((part.CFrame * offset).Position)
if onScreen then
valid = true
minX = math.min(minX, screen.X)
maxX = math.max(maxX, screen.X)
minY = math.min(minY, screen.Y)
maxY = math.max(maxY, screen.Y)
end
end
end
if not valid then return nil end
local width = math.max(10, maxX - minX)
local height = math.max(10, maxY - minY)
return width * widthScale, height * widthScale, Vector2.new(minX + (maxX - minX) / 2,
minY)
end

local hrp = state.humanoidRootPart
if not hrp then return nil end
local top, topOn = worldToScreen((hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 0)).Position)
local bottom, bottomOn = worldToScreen((hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, -3.5, 0)).Position)
if not topOn or not bottomOn then return nil end
local height = math.max(10, (top - bottom).Magnitude)
return height * 0.55 * widthScale * 2, height * widthScale, bottom
end

local toPart = state.parts[pair[2]]
if not fromPart or not toPart then continue end
local from, onFrom = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(fromPart.Position)
local to, onTo = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(toPart.Position)
if not onFrom or not onTo then continue end
local line = state.lines[i]

function ESP:update(player)

and not Toggles.esp_weapon.Value and not Toggles.esp_box.Value

end

end

self.skins = {}
self.charms = {}
self.finishers = {}
self.ownableWeapons = {}
local function getEquippedItem(character)
return character and character:FindFirstChild("EquippedItem")
end
local function weaponOf(item)
return item and item.Info and item.Info.Name or (item and item.Name)
end
local function itemIndex(item)
return item and item.Data and item.Data.ItemIndex
end
function self:loadSaveData()
-- proto 278/285: cosmetics_changer_save_data (JSON)
local data = Options.cosmetics_changer_save_data.Value
if not data or data == "" then return end
local ok, decoded = pcall(function()
return HttpService:JSONDecode(data)
end)
if ok and decoded then
self.skins = decoded.skins or {}
self.charms = decoded.charms or {}
self.finishers = decoded.finishers or {}
end
end
function self:saveData()

local payload = HttpService:JSONEncode({
skins = self.skins,
charms = self.charms,
finishers = self.finishers,
})
Options.cosmetics_changer_save_data:SetValue(payload)
end
function self:applySkin(character, skinName)
local item = getEquippedItem(character)
if not item then return end
local name = weaponOf(item)
local skin = self.skins[name] or skinName
if not skin or skin == "none" then return end
local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle then
pcall(function()
handle.TextureID = skin
end)
end
for _, desc in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
if desc:IsA("Texture") then
pcall(function()
desc.Texture = skin
end)
elseif desc:IsA("SpecialMesh") or desc:IsA("MeshPart") then
pcall(function()
desc.TextureId = skin
end)
end
end
Library:Notify("applied " .. (skinName or skin) .. " to " .. name, 2)
end
function self:applyCharm(character, charmName)
if not charmName or charmName == "none" then return end
local item = getEquippedItem(character)
if not item then return end
local charm = self.charms[charmName]
if not charm then return end
local handle = item:FindFirstChild("Handle")

-- viewmodel camera sway (proto 811: _sway_spring, match_axis)
local sway = { x = 0, y = 0 }
function self:updateSway(dt, character)
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return end
local item = character and character:FindFirstChild("EquippedItem")
local vm = item and item.ViewModel
if not vm then return end
local speed = Options.viewmodel_recoil.Value or 0.5
local targetX = -math.rad(Options.viewmodel_offset_x.Value or 0)
local targetY = -math.rad(Options.viewmodel_offset_y.Value or 0)
sway.x = sway.x + (targetX - sway.x) * speed * dt
sway.y = sway.y + (targetY - sway.y) * speed * dt
vm.CFrame = vm.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(sway.x, sway.y, 0)
end
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
updateFov()
updateAspectRatio()
antiFlashbang()
cameraBlur()
end)
return self
end

function self:fire(origin, target)

local to = target
if posLerp < 1 then
from = from:Lerp(to, posLerp)
end

local ol = makeLine()
ol.From = from
ol.To = to
ol.Thickness = line.Thickness + 2
ol.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
ol.Visible = true
table.insert(self.tracers, {
line = ol,
start = now,
lifetime = Options.custom_tracer_lifetime.Value,
})
end
if emission > 0 then
local particle = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
particle.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.1)
particle.Rate = 0

particle.Color = ColorSequence.new(line.Color)

task.delay(0.5, function()
particle:Destroy()
end)
end
table.insert(self.tracers, {
line = line,
start = now,
lifetime = Options.custom_tracer_lifetime.Value,
length = length,
speed = speed,
})
end

template = text
end
template = string.gsub(template, "{NAME}", targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Name or "?")

template = string.gsub(template, "{DMG}", tostring(math.round(damage or 0)))
template = string.gsub(template, "{PART}", partName or "?")
template = string.gsub(template, "{WEAPON}", weapon or "?")
local duration = Options.target_hit_notify_duration.Value
pcall(function()
Library:Notify(template, duration)
end)
end

local GameMechanics = (function()
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local GameMechanics = {}
GameMechanics.__index = GameMechanics
-- ============================================================
-- PROTECTED TARGET CHECKS (protos 800/801/802 + 456)
-- targeting_ignore_protected_settings: "katana deflecting" /
-- "blocked by riot shield" — real Magma mechanics the cheat hooks
-- ============================================================
function GameMechanics:isBlockedByRiotShield(character)
if not character then return false end
local item = character:FindFirstChild("EquippedItem")
if not item then return false end
if item.Name ~= "Riot Shield" and (item.Info and item.Info.Name ~= "Riot Shield") then
return false
end
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if not cam or not hrp then return false end
local toTarget = (hrp.Position - cam.CFrame.Position).Unit
local shieldFacing = (item.GetRotationCFrame and item:GetRotationCFrame() or
item.CFrame).LookVector
local dot = toTarget:Dot(shieldFacing)
-- blocked when the shield face points at us (dot > 1.66 is the front block

-- threshold; dot < 0.77 means facing away - not blocking)
if dot > 1.66 then
return true
end
return false
end
function GameMechanics:isKatanaDeflecting(character)
if not character then return false end
local item = character:FindFirstChild("EquippedItem")
if not item then return false end
local name = item.Name or ""
if name ~= "Katana" and not (item.Info and item.Info.Name == "Katana") then
return false
end
-- katana deflect window: recent deflect hash set on the client fighter
local fighter = character:FindFirstChild("ClientFighter")
local deflectHash = fighter and fighter._deflect_hash
if deflectHash and deflectHash > 0 then
local now = tick()
if now - deflectHash < 0.3 then
return true
end
end
-- fallback: melee state with block
local stateOk, state = pcall(function()
return item:GetState()
end)
if stateOk and (state == Enum.ItemState.Blocked or state == "Blocking") then
return true
end
return false
end
function GameMechanics:targetingRules(character, distance)
local rules = {}
rules.visibleOnly = Toggles.targeting_visibleonly.Value
rules.limitDistance = Toggles.targeting_limitdistance.Value
rules.maxDistance = Options.targeting_maxdistance.Value
rules.reactionTime = Options.targeting_reactiontime.Value
rules.forgetTime = Options.targeting_forgettime.Value
rules.partBlacklist = Options.targeting_closest_part_blacklist.Value or {}
rules.ignoreProtected = Toggles.targeting_ignore_protected.Value
if rules.visibleOnly then
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cam then
local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if hrp then
local screen, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
if not onScreen then
return false
end
end

end
end
if rules.limitDistance and distance and distance > rules.maxDistance then
return false
end
if rules.ignoreProtected and self:isProtectedTarget(character) then
return false
end
if character then
for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
if rules.partBlacklist[part.Name] then
return false
end
end
end
return true
end
function GameMechanics:isProtectedTarget(character)
if not character then return false end
local settings = Options.targeting_ignore_protected_settings.Value or {}
if settings["blocked by riot shield"] and self:isBlockedByRiotShield(character) then
return true
end
if settings["katana deflecting"] and self:isKatanaDeflecting(character) then
return true
end
return false
end
-- attack cooldown tracking (proto 800)
function GameMechanics.new()
local self = setmetatable({}, GameMechanics)
self.attackCooldowns = {}
function self:canAttack(character, item)
if not item then return false end
local now = tick()
local last = self.attackCooldowns[character]
local cooldown = item.Info and item.Info.HeavyAttackCooldown or 0.2
if last and now - last < cooldown then
return false
end
return true
end
function self:markAttack(character)
self.attackCooldowns[character] = tick()
end
return self
end

-- ============================================================
-- EQUIPPED ITEM TRACKER (protos 74/76)
-- ============================================================
function GameMechanics:trackEquippedItems(callback)
local event = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
local function hook(character)
if not character then return end
local last = nil
character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
if child.Name == "EquippedItem" then
last = child
event:Fire(character, child)
if callback then callback(character, child) end
end
end)
character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
if child == last then
last = nil
end
end)
end
local function onAdded(character)
hook(character)
if character:FindFirstChild("EquippedItem") then
event:Fire(character, character.EquippedItem)
if callback then callback(character, character.EquippedItem) end
end
end
if LocalPlayer.Character then
onAdded(LocalPlayer.Character)
end
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(onAdded)
return event
end

-- ============================================================
-- GRENADE (protos 100/476)
-- _CreateTractoryVisual + _cook_detonate_delay
-- ============================================================
function GameMechanics:createGrenadeTrajectory(startPosition, velocity, maxTime)
if not Toggles.custom_tracer_enabled.Value then return end
local points = {}
local pos = startPosition
local vel = velocity
local gravity = Vector3.new(0, -9.81 * 4, 0)
local dt = 0.05
local t = 0
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

while t < (maxTime or 3) do
pos = pos + vel * dt
vel = vel + gravity * dt
t = t + dt
table.insert(points, pos)
end
for i = 1, #points - 1 do
local line = Drawing.new("Line")
line.From = points[i]
line.To = points[i + 1]
line.Thickness = 0.2
line.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
line.Transparency = 1 - (i / #points)
line.Visible = true
task.delay((maxTime or 3), function()
line:Remove()
end)
end
end

function self:chatSpam()

local function spam()
